pages.title: Just Right
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Bring everyday objects into order in Just Right. Sort, stack and match items as each small puzzle asks for a different arrangement. Inspect the shapes and patterns to work out where everything belongs, then move the pieces until the scene is complete.

pages.title: Twilight Mahjong Manor
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Break a curse through tile puzzles in Twilight Mahjong Manor. Remove free identical pairs to earn the resources needed for rebuilding the estate. Use shuffle, hint or undo when a layout hides the matches required to restore another part of the manor.

pages.title: Climb Up
pages.creator: Fly Studios Games
pages.description: Launch a cube up a mountain in Climb Up. Drag to aim along the dotted trajectory and pull farther for a longer leap. Adapt to fresh layouts with spikes, saws, pistons and moving platforms as you try to reach the top.

pages.title: Landing Hero
pages.creator: Pixelarry
pages.description: Draw safe approach routes for aircraft in Landing Hero. Guide planes toward the runway at a suitable angle while keeping their paths apart. Manage several arrivals at once, since one collision ends the air-traffic-control attempt.

pages.title: Puzzle Trails
pages.creator: Betik Bilişim
pages.description: Rearrange picture tiles in Puzzle Trails. Slide pieces into the right order to progress along the map and unlock more image categories. Collect coins and points from completed puzzles, using bonuses when an arrangement is hard to finish.

pages.title: Float for Brainrots
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Search dangerous seas for rare creatures in Float for Brainrots. Start from a raft, manage the timer and use islands to stay safe from sharks. Improve boat speed and capacity to reach deeper water, either alone or with a second player.

pages.title: Yoga Master
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Move a runner into poses that fit the route in Yoga Master. Swipe to change position and adjust the body before passing furniture. Read the next obstacle early enough to choose the pose that lets the character continue.

pages.title: Pim Path
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Reach the trophy at the far end of each course in Pim Path. Time jumps over gaps and avoid the spikes and blades around the platforms. A missed landing ends the attempt, so study the next section before advancing.

pages.title: Clash Crowd Game
pages.creator: Alpha Games
pages.description: Lead a moving group through traps in Clash Crowd Game. Guide the crowd along the route, collect members and look for room to pass the obstacles ahead. Get as much of the team as possible to the destination.

pages.title: Animal Bus Traffic Jam
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sort small passengers into their matching vehicles in Animal Bus Traffic Jam. Check the animals and colors before deciding which group should move next. Use the space opened by one departure to clear another part of the busy parking area.

pages.title: Sand Block Blast
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Drop shaped pieces that crumble into grains in Sand Block Blast. Plan where the falling sand can collect and form complete lines to clear space. Keep the pile manageable as you fit another shape into the changing field.

pages.title: Sort And Style: Back To School
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Organize nine messy spaces in Sort And Style: Back To School. Put objects away in desks, lockers, wardrobes and lunch boxes, then move to a final dress-up activity. Choose a uniform, shoes and hairstyle for the finished school look.

pages.title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Play through a large card-puzzle journey in Solitaire Farm Seasons 4. Visit locations including Greenland and Nepal while developing crops associated with the maps. Complete solitaire layouts and take part in seasonal events as the farm tour expands.

pages.title: Woody Tap Block
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Tap wooden blocks away from a structure in Woody Tap Block. Check the direction each one can travel before selecting it and remove the pieces that are free first. Open paths through the arrangement until every block can leave.

pages.title: Candy Chain Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Drag across neighboring sweets to form chains in Candy Chain Master. Make groups of at least three and turn every blue square golden by clearing candy on it. Plan enough coverage to finish the whole board before time expires.

pages.title: Light Line
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Fill a connected shape with a continuous route in Light Line. Begin on the colored tile and travel across the empty squares without leaving a blank section. Work out the order of branches before drawing through the more difficult layouts.

pages.title: ROYAL COIN RUSH
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Swap adjacent pieces to make rows of matching currency in ROYAL COIN RUSH. Groups of four or more create special coins, which can be combined for stronger effects. Remove the target coins to clear each stage.

pages.title: Nubik in the Monster World
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Rescue captured kittens in Nubik in the Monster World. Fight Huggy's creatures with weapons such as rifles or a grenade launcher, collect loot and improve your equipment. Watch for traps and use TNT where it helps open the way.

pages.title: 2 Player Mini Challenge
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Choose a head-to-head activity in 2 Player Mini Challenge. Share the same device with a friend or play against the computer. Switch between the collection's short contests when you want to test a different skill.

pages.title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Prepare stronger weapons before a survival round in Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie. Buy guns and combine identical ones into better models, then fire at the advancing undead and crows. Keep enemies from reaching you while using the improved ammunition.

pages.title: Farm Triple Match
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Make sets of three identical pictures in Farm Triple Match. Select tiles that uncover more useful pieces and clear each layout to progress. Use completed levels to develop a farm with animals and a garden.

pages.title: Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator
pages.creator: TearForge Studios
pages.description: Send a ragdoll off tall structures in Mega Fall Ragdoll Simulator. Choose a starting approach that produces a stronger chain of impacts through each level. Earn coins from the falls and unlock new character appearances for later attempts.

pages.title: Seek & Find
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Search illustrated scenes for requested objects in Seek & Find. Scan the landscape for the small details concealed among the larger shapes. Work through the maps and discover more secrets as you locate the last item in each scene.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pro 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear colored clusters in Bubble Shooter Pro 4. Use bombs or firebombs when they can remove several pieces together, then collect stars to finish missions. Try the bonus gifts and unlock visual customizations for later bubble-popping rounds.

pages.title: Idle Firefighter 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Respond to new emergencies in Idle Firefighter 3D. Move the firefighter to put out flames and reach trapped survivors before the situation spreads. Keep the extinguisher supplied so a depleted tool does not stop the rescue.

pages.title: Offline FPS Royale
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight computer-controlled enemies in Offline FPS Royale. Move through the three-dimensional map and look for threats from different directions. Keep clearing opponents to work toward completing the battlefield.

pages.title: Off Road Overdrive
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Balance a vehicle over side-scrolling hills in Off Road Overdrive. Adjust speed and tilt to the ground ahead, then try Challenge mode across snow, fields or desert terrain. Replay a route to improve the result without overturning the car.

pages.title: Ramp Bike Jumping
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Launch a rider from a ramp in Ramp Bike Jumping. Try motorbikes, bicycles or skis and see how the approach affects the jump. Push for more distance as you experiment with the game's exaggerated stunt physics.

pages.title: Tripeaks Solitaire Holiday
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Clear card arrangements during a cruise in Tripeaks Solitaire Holiday. Choose playable cards in sequence and try to use fewer turns to finish a layout. Visit landmarks such as the Pyramids and Taj Mahal as more puzzles become available.

pages.title: Pixel Block 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Roll a block across every pixel of a shape in Pixel Block 3D. Choose directions that keep it on the surface, since an opening can send it falling. Cover the remaining pieces to finish each level.

pages.title: Perfect Stylish Street Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress friends for a weekend celebration in Perfect Stylish Street Look. Explore their wardrobes for streetwear and coordinate the pieces into separate outfits. Help the group carry out Noah's idea for a themed party.

pages.title: Temple Jewels
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Swap colorful gems into groups of three or more in Temple Jewels. Make rows or columns to remove pieces and score, looking for longer matches when the board allows. Keep building your total in the ancient-temple setting.

pages.title: Flower Fairy Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give Ava and Emma fantasy looks in Flower Fairy Makeover. Start with flower-inspired makeup, then choose outfits, crowns, wands and shoes. Coordinate each girl's accessories to finish her transformation into a fairy.

pages.title: Stack Fire Rider 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Guide a ball through a track of blocks in Stack Fire Rider 3D. Collect useful pieces and break the orange barriers that can be destroyed. Steer away from the remaining dangers until the ball reaches the finish.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear layered pairs in Solitaire Mahjong Classic. Choose free matching tiles from the traditional ivory-and-green board and think about what each removal uncovers. Keep opening the arrangement until every piece has been paired.

pages.title: Count Master
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Guide a crowd of stick figures in Count Master. Swipe between sides of the course to gather more members and get around the dangers ahead. Bring the larger group through the run to improve its chances at the finish.

pages.title: Heli Battle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Pilot a helicopter against another chopper in Heli Battle. Tap to climb or release to descend, and collect ammunition to fire missiles. Be the first to score ten hits and win the aerial match.

pages.title: Cube Craft Survival
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Gather your own supplies in Cube Craft Survival. Explore the land for food, clothing and tools from the needs list, watching the wildlife around you. Craft or collect what is missing so the character can keep living in the open world.

pages.title: Plug Run Race
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Control a plug-shaped runner in Plug Run Race. Hold to move along the track and charge through the course toward the finish. Time your progress around the runway's obstacles to arrive before the other plugs.

pages.title: Stick Archers Battle
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Judge the angle and power of each shot in Stick Archers Battle. Adapt to changing scenery as you trade arrows with an opponent. Try solo, two-player or deathmatch modes, with five points needed to claim the match.

pages.title: Crazy Football War
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Compete in vehicle football in Crazy Football War. Drive into the ball to attack the opposing net and block the next return. Travel through different arenas as you try to win the championship matches.

pages.title: Link the Dots
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Join numbered points in sequence in Link the Dots. Draw from one to the next to reveal the concealed shape. Complete the outline more quickly to earn a better score before moving to the next picture.

pages.title: Popcorn Master
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Hold to fill a container in Popcorn Master. Release before the expanding popcorn spills over the edge and keep every piece inside the target area. Finish one bucket to continue to the next arrangement.

pages.title: Flip Champs
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Release an acrobat at the right point of a swing in Flip Champs. Judge the arc to provide enough force for the next transfer. Learn how the timing affects the landing as you work through the barriers.

pages.title: Clean Ocean
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Pick discarded objects out of underwater scenes in Clean Ocean. Look for rubbish among the animals and plants, then click it to remove the pollution. Search the remaining details until the water is clear.

pages.title: Color Roll 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Unroll colored sheets in the right order in Color Roll 3D. Compare the example to see which layer belongs above another before tapping. Recreate the visible pattern by controlling the overlaps.

pages.title: Christmas Balloons Bursting
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pop the requested balloons in Christmas Balloons Bursting. Check how many the round asks you to hit and click the targets as they appear. Try to complete more successful bursts and improve the last score.

pages.title: Blades Battle
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Fight rival spinning blades in Blades Battle. Defeat opponents to become larger and stronger while keeping your own blade alive. Choose a color and work toward being the last fighter in the arena.

pages.title: Playful Puppy Outdoor Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct six dog pictures in Playful Puppy Outdoor Puzzle. Choose a layout ranging from sixteen to one hundred pieces and use the puppy's outline and scenery to join them. Complete each scene before trying another difficulty.

pages.title: Fall Boys : Stupid Fighters
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Grab other characters and throw them from the platform in Fall Boys : Stupid Fighters. Keep yourself away from the edge while looking for a chance to lift an opponent. Try different maps and unlock costumes as you compete with friends.

pages.title: Avoid Traffic
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Get a traveler back to his car in Avoid Traffic. Use the arrow keys to choose when to step into the road and wait when a vehicle blocks the route. Complete the crossing without getting struck by the fast-moving traffic.

pages.title: Homescapes
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Open barriers in the right order to rescue a captive in Homescapes. Check how the garden's traps separate the man from his partner before releasing a gate. Use the mechanisms against robbers and dogs while clearing a safe route.

pages.title: Wobble Boss
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Sneak through a multi-floor building in Wobble Boss. Avoid other agents and use the terrain or mechanisms to reach the next floor. Keep looking for the route to the mission's secret while patrols try to catch you.

pages.title: Blocky Looter Thief 3D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Collect valuables while evading patrols in Blocky Looter Thief 3D. Guide the thief through the environment and grab loot when the route is clear. Move away before a guard's approach cuts off the escape.

pages.title: Candy Cake Maker
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Prepare a dessert from its ingredients in Candy Cake Maker. Add the items in the order shown to make the dough, then continue with the remaining baking steps. Finish the cake and choose details for its candy decoration.

pages.title: Stickman Simulator Final Battle!!
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Deploy troops before the fight in Stickman Simulator Final Battle!! Choose a formation that can handle the enemy force, then watch the armies clash. Change the lineup between battles to get a stronger result from your stick-figure units.

pages.title: Dr. Parking 4
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Maneuver through marked spaces in Dr. Parking 4. Use the arrow keys to steer the car around barriers and bring it into the requested parking position. Work through multi-stage routes that call for increasingly precise control.

pages.title: Modern Commando Combat
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fight through a battlefield in Modern Commando Combat. Move into cover, identify opposing fighters and line up shots to clear the next area. Keep watching for another enemy as you advance through the military missions.

pages.title: Collect More Candy
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Catch falling sweets in Collect More Candy. Tap each piece before it reaches the ground and keep the collection going as another appears. React quickly enough to build your total before the round ends.

pages.title: Fast Line Furious Car Racing
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Choose a sports car and enter events in Fast Line Furious Car Racing. Try career races, elimination tournaments or time trials as you learn each circuit. Steer through the bends and work toward finishing ahead of the other drivers.

pages.title: Paint Pop 3D
pages.creator: GamePop
pages.description: Fire paint at the rotating tower in Paint Pop 3D. Time bursts so they color the rings while the route is clear. Finish covering the target sections to complete the current tower and continue.

pages.title: Jelly Match Worlds
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Swap colorful pieces to collect the required jellies in Jelly Match Worlds. Watch the mission before choosing matches and use the spaces left by one group to reach another. Work through ninety-nine boards with different collection goals.

pages.title: Mancala 3D
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Play a stone-sowing contest against another player in Mancala 3D. Choose one of your six pits and distribute its stones around the board according to the rules. Plan the next turn while gathering more stones into your side's store.

pages.title: Point Drag
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Time your turns around a circuit in Point Drag. Use the mouse or finger to guide one of four sports cars through the bends and keep it inside the track. Improve the run by making each drift at the right moment.

pages.title: Free Zombie
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Aim a pistol at the approaching undead in Free Zombie. Shoot before an enemy gets past your position and watch the remaining rounds between bursts. Reload when needed and keep clearing targets to improve your score.

pages.title: Christmas Baubles Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Match three or more ornaments in Christmas Baubles Match 3. Keep the left-hand meter from dropping too far while searching for another group. Watch the pieces that shift into place so you can continue scoring through the holiday board.

pages.title: Vintage German Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble twelve vehicle pictures in Vintage German Cars Jigsaw. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces for each board and use the bodywork and background to connect them. Complete the image before moving to another classic car.

pages.title: BTS Rabbit Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color four bunny drawings in BTS Rabbit Coloring Book. Select a picture and apply the shades you want to its outlines. Try different palettes across the pages to give each rabbit its own appearance.

pages.title: Monster Truck Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Compete on rough circuits in Monster Truck Driving Simulator. Enter championships or try drag and freestyle modes, using the heavy truck's power for jumps and flips. Keep its balance when the wheels return to the track.

pages.title: Mr Archer
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Aim at ropes to free captives in Mr Archer. Adjust the arrow's path before firing so it cuts the support without striking the person below. Work out the safest shot as the positions change.

pages.title: Pixel PUBG
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose among five characters and enter one of two maps in Pixel PUBG. Find weapons around the area and use them against the opposing fighters. Keep moving between useful positions as you try to eliminate everyone else.

pages.title: Halloween Scary Jungle Road Drive
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive through a haunted woodland in Halloween Scary Jungle Road Drive. Follow Jamie's attempt to investigate the route while watching for ghosts before the finish. React to the warnings as the dark road presents another danger.

pages.title: Funny Ear Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help a patient with a blocked ear in Funny Ear Surgery. Follow the clinic's prompts and use the on-screen instruments to complete the simulated treatment. Finish the steps needed to restore Sora's hearing in the story.

pages.title: Ragdoll 2 Player
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose a floppy fighter and battle an opponent in Ragdoll 2 Player. Move the character to land hits while keeping it alive long enough to win. Advance through solo fights or challenge a friend with separate keyboard controls.

pages.title: Hyper Scary Halloween Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Find identical spooky pictures in Hyper Scary Halloween Party. Reveal one card, then turn over the position you think hides its partner. Use information from mismatches to clear every pair from the table.

pages.title: Minecaves Lost in Space
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide Steve out of dangerous caves in Minecaves Lost in Space. Collect diamonds and stars to open doors, gather weapons and clear the monsters ahead. Watch for rivers, spikes and other traps while solving the route through each cavern.

pages.title: Monster Truck Speed Race
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Race large off-road vehicles in Monster Truck Speed Race. Use WASD to steer over hills and desert tracks, keeping the truck balanced through rough sections. Build enough speed to compete without losing control at the next landing.

pages.title: Pet Runner
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Run through varied locations in Pet Runner. Drag to jump, slide or change lanes as trucks, buses and trains block the route. Collect coins while traveling through the city, forest, beach and subway settings.

pages.title: Soccer Pro
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Carry a football past incoming tackles in Soccer Pro. Read the pitch before choosing a route and use slow motion when you need time to plan. Unlock more star players as you work toward longer dribbles and more goals.

pages.title: Xtreme Good Guys vs Bad
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Join a side in Xtreme Good Guys vs Bad and enter a team deathmatch. Pick from nine weapons and move through the map to find the opposing fighters. Use the mouse to aim while keeping cover between attacks.

pages.title: Heavy Crane Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Operate lifting equipment in Heavy Crane Simulator. Drive the selected machine into position, activate the crane and control the arm and hook to handle the load. Rotate or zoom the camera to check how the cargo lines up.

pages.title: Crazy Scientist
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Collect different weapons on an unusual combat run in Crazy Scientist. Use the space bar and up arrow to manage the action as you work through the threats. Keep finding the next weapon to explore what it can do.

pages.title: Aligator Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild twelve reptile pictures in Aligator Puzzle. Pick the image you want and choose one of three difficulty modes, then fit its pieces into place. Use the animal's outline and markings to identify neighboring sections.

pages.title: Helicopter Parking and Racing Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fly and land several aircraft in Helicopter Parking and Racing Simulator. Try precise parking tasks or follow a route of checkpoints in the second mode. Use WASD for movement, Q and E to turn and the height controls to line up a landing.

pages.title: EG Jelly Match
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange colorful sweets into matching lines in EG Jelly Match. Drag a piece into position to form a group of three and remove it from the board. Keep finding another combination as new opportunities appear.

pages.title: Ballhit.io
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Compete on island, forest and snow arenas in Ballhit.io. Push the control behind your ball to send it forward in the direction it faces. Try to knock other players out while keeping yourself inside the arena.

pages.title: Free Fall
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Steer a falling cube through a three-dimensional obstacle field in Free Fall. Watch the barriers below and move into a clear gap before the cube reaches them. Collect coins along the descent and try to extend the run.

pages.title: Easter Day Coloring
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Paint seasonal pictures in Easter Day Coloring. Choose among six drawings and use twenty-four colors to fill them quickly for a higher score. Save or print the finished image when you want to keep it.

pages.title: EG Save Pilot
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Avoid rockets and fire at hostile planes in EG Save Pilot. Collect useful items to increase your score while steering through incoming attacks. Adjust to the rising speed and stronger aircraft as the fight continues.

pages.title: Pixel War
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fire at enemies in a scrolling field in Pixel War. Guide your fighter through the route while watching for threats entering from ahead. Keep shooting and move away from return fire to continue the run.

pages.title: Vampires and Garlic
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Throw garlic explosives at hiding enemies in Vampires and Garlic. Set the angle and strength, then use the terrain or nearby objects to reach the target. Plan around boxes, pulleys and TNT while making the limited supply of bombs count.

pages.title: Purify the Last Forest
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a white deer through a threatened woodland in Purify the Last Forest. Pick up lost fawns and help reunite them with their mothers while avoiding hazards along the route. Keep the group safe through the running challenge.

pages.title: Cute Car Racing
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Steer a small vehicle through traffic in Cute Car Racing. Collect the dollars scattered along the road while keeping clear of the other cars. Choose a favorite model and see how long you can keep the collection going.

pages.title: Don't touch them!
pages.creator: INDIEG4M3S
pages.description: Shoot slimes approaching from both sides in Don't touch them! Aim the bow toward each threat and use the unlimited arrows before it reaches you. Every slime defeated adds to the score, so keep checking both directions.

pages.title: Arkanoid For Painters
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Draw temporary platforms to keep a ball in play in Arkanoid For Painters. Bounce it into blocks while managing the mana needed to draw in air or water. Improve the tools through fifteen upgrades as you clear twenty-five levels.

pages.title: Mini Muncher
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Move tuna cans to free a chocolate bar in Mini Muncher. Inspect the grid and slide the containers into openings that clear a route for the treat. Finish the puzzle with as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Coloring Bloxy Boy
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint a blocky character in Coloring Bloxy Boy. Change the frame, surrounding items or background to create a different scene, then choose colors for its details. Keep experimenting until the finished picture has the look you want.

pages.title: Save The Monsters
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fire arrows to free captives in Save The Monsters. Aim carefully at the supports holding each creature and keep the shot away from the monster itself. Use the objects around the level to find a safe route for the arrow.

pages.title: Super Scary Stacker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Stack Halloween figures in Super Scary Stacker. Place each shape where it can support the next one without tipping the pile. Use the different outlines carefully so the whole tower stays standing after the last piece.

pages.title: Webimon
pages.creator: Josh Tam Universe
pages.description: Care for a small creature in Webimon. Feed it, give it water, wash it and provide play or exercise as its needs change. The way you look after the pet influences which kind of monster it eventually becomes.

pages.title: Wheely 4
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help a little car find its route in Wheely 4. Click Wheely and the surrounding objects to operate bridges or other mechanisms. Solve the puzzles and get past lasers as the journey moves between different environments.

pages.title: Jasmine and Ariel Wardrobe Swap
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Share clothing between two friends in Jasmine and Ariel Wardrobe Swap. Try each princess's clothes on the other, then mix pieces from both wardrobes. Put together new combinations for their day of borrowing one another's style.

pages.title: Blue Warehouse Escape Episode 1
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Search for clues in Blue Warehouse Escape Episode 1. Inspect the stored objects and solve the puzzles hiding a route outside. Use what you find to unlock the barriers that keep you in the blue room.

pages.title: Princesses X-Mas Tree Fashion
pages.creator: Next Vision Solutions
pages.description: Style a group of royals for a decorating day in Princesses X-Mas Tree Fashion. Choose winter clothes and coordinate the accessories for each princess. Finish their outfits before they begin preparing the Christmas tree.

pages.title: Zombie Head
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Roll loose heads back to their bodies in Zombie Head. Remove blocks and use dynamite to open the route while avoiding the obstacles in each scene. Collect the stars when the path allows it and reunite every zombie.
